_comment: What a Stream Deck (or anything like it) needs to reach the buttons. Replace host and matrix for your setup. All requests are GET or POST, no auth, lab network only.

api.content_type: application/json responses; requests are query strings or JSON bodies

fields.incoming: list of {port, alpha, since}: light the key whose target matches 'port' amber
fields.talking_to: list of port numbers: light those keys red
fields.listening: list of port numbers: light those keys green

bitfocus_companion.feedback: Generic HTTP connection -> poll feedback.poll into a variable and use 'variable contains' feedbacks on each button
bitfocus_companion.note: Companion runs on the same machine as the Stream Deck; it does not need to run where the simulator runs.

streamdeck_app_native.limitation: press only, no release and no feedback. Use mode=latch buttons.

audio_for_the_operator.note: A Stream Deck has no microphone or speaker. Run TRUNK-SIMULATOR/trunk_panel.py on the same port number so the deck presses the keys and the computer carries the voice.
audio_for_the_operator.command: python ../TRUNK-SIMULATOR/trunk_panel.py --matrix {host}:{series_plus_port}   (series = 20000 + 256 x capital number; London port 5 = 22309)
